# Riverbanc

> Riverbanc Technology Limited is a Zambia-based technology platform that helps salaried employees compare available loan options from participating financial institutions.

Riverbanc provides a comparison and application-handoff experience. It does not issue loans or make lending decisions. Product availability, rates, fees, eligibility and approval decisions are determined by the relevant financial institution and must be confirmed with that institution.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.riverbanc.co.zm/): Platform overview and how Riverbanc works.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.riverbanc.co.zm/privacy-policy): How Riverbanc handles personal information.
- [Data Retention Policy](https://www.riverbanc.co.zm/retention-policy): Information retention and deletion practices.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.riverbanc.co.zm/terms): Terms governing use of the platform.
